invariant: A character the simple path does not draw from Menlo Bold Italic's own cmap is measured with the advance of the font JRS substitutes, not with Menlo's cell and not with .notdef.
causal_divergence: cell_count charges one Menlo cell (1233/2048 of the size) for every non-hidden token. Menlo's .notdef equals that cell, so simple-path misses are already right. The 267 scalars Menlo Bold maps and Menlo Bold Italic does not are absent from Bold Italic's S runs, so resolve() returns Mapped and the cell is charged. Java's simple path draws a fallback glyph with that font's own advance. The chain TSVs name the cascade slots and do not record the fallback advance.
planned_change: After the relayed probe returns each scalar's bold and bold-italic getStringBounds, measure those scalars with the fallback advance the probe identifies, using a face whose advance is already in the chain data when the probe matches one. Do not invent an advance. A scalar whose probe width equals the cell stays a cell.
